scenes.hook: Your phone has no nearby cell tower. Some supported services can send messages through a satellite instead.
scenes.idea: The signal travels between a compatible phone, a satellite, and the network on the ground.
scenes.demo: This can extend connectivity beyond regular tower coverage, depending on the service and where you are.
scenes.compare: It is not automatically a replacement for normal mobile broadband. Speed, supported apps, and delays can differ.
scenes.takeaway: Check your phone, provider, region, and clear view of the sky before relying on a feature.
scenes.close: Would messaging be enough off the grid? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
